visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black baseball cap and a black long-sleeved shirt sits at a white table in a well-lit living room, holding a large orange box labeled 'EVERYTHING, AND ANYTH' and 'TAOBAO IT!'. (2) He starts unboxing the package while a young girl in a white t-shirt leans in with an excited facial expression and wide eyes. (3) They pull out a cream-colored tote bag featuring orange cartoon mascots and hold it up for the camera; the man points to the mascot. (4) An insert shot shows the man's hands handling an orange phone lanyard with small mascot charms, then a deck of orange playing cards. (5) The man presents a white metal cup with 'MY MORNING' text and a mascot illustration to the camera while the girl observes. (6) They open a smaller orange box which contains an orange mystery bag, and the girl reaches inside with anticipation. (7) The girl reveals an orange plush doll and smiles broadly, holding it close to her face. (8) A woman with pink-toned hair appears on screen, holding the orange doll which is now dressed in a small pink outfit. (9) A close-up shot features a small white fluffy dog looking curiously at the doll held by the girl. (10) The orange mascot plush is finally placed on a shelf inside a clear case, standing next to another popular plush character (Labubu).
